//Registration: Seed default only. On first read the value moves into platform.instance_settings and a host administrator edits it in the host console from then on; changing it here afterwards has no effect.
//HostAdmin: Break-glass only. Identity-provider subjects listed here reach the host console even without the identity.users.is_host_admin flag, so an installation whose last host administrator was lost is recoverable. Normally empty; the first host admin is created from Bootstrap:AdminSubject. Also accepts a comma-separated HostAdmin__Subjects environment variable.
//InstanceLogs: The host console's persisted log store (platform.instance_logs). MinimumLevel is deliberately Warning, not Information: these records are persisted and may contain user data, and the OpenTelemetry pipeline already carries the full stream. RetentionDays is what bounds how long that data lives.
